title: lean-spectral-theory
abstract: The spectral theorem for possibly unbounded self-adjoint operators on complex Hilbert spaces, formalized through the Cayley transform and real projection-valued measures. The selected spectral theorem constructs a PVM whose scalar measures give the exact finite-second-moment domain and first-moment quadratic form, with measurable-set uniqueness, and is proved equivalent to equality with the unbounded coordinate spectral integral. The selected Stone theorem proves both that strongly continuous one-parameter unitary groups have self-adjoint generators and that every self-adjoint operator generates such a group.
